title.value: Guiding The Last Layer in Federated Learning with Pre-Trained Models
title.justification: The paper focuses on federated learning using pre-trained models, specifically guiding the last layer in this process.
title.quote: Abstract Federated Learning (FL) is an emerging paradigm that allows a model to be trained across a number of participants without sharing data. Recent works have begun to consider the effects of using pre-trained models as an initialization point for existing FL algorithms..."

extractions.description: This paper explores federated learning (FL) where pre-trained models are used as a basis to improve efficiency and accuracy. The study introduces methods to improve the last layer adjustments during transfer learning in federated settings, presenting techniques such as the FedNCM approach. It demonstrates how these methods can reduce communication and computation costs while maintaining performance.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is federated learning and efficiency in machine learning models, with no direct mention of climate change applications or considerations.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Here we revisit the problem of FL from a pre-trained model considered in prior work and expand it to a set of computer vision transfer learning problems.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not address climate change themes directly; it focuses on federated learning and computational efficiency, which may have indirect applications in climate-related areas but are not explicitly discussed.
primary_category.quote: Our contributions in this work are: • We provide empirical evidence that, for numerous downstream datasets, training only the classifier head proves to be an effective approach in FL settings.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper solely concentrates on issues of federated learning and computational methods, and does not mention other climate change categories.
secondary_categories.quote: Transfer learning and the effects of pre-training in FL have so far only been explored in limited capacity.
